item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - THE ERAS TOUR: THE FINAL SHOW PERFORMANCES
item.description:
Hi everyone,

I’m currently looking for a version of The Eras Tour – The Final Show where the official concert film is split into individual performances, instead of one full continuous movie.

Specifically, I’m hoping to find:

  • Separate video files for each era / performance (e.g. Lover, Fearless, Red, Speak Now, Reputation, 1989, folklore, evermore, Midnights, etc.)

  • High quality if possible (1080p / 4K preferred)

  • Sources from the official film or high-quality rips are both fine
The reason I’m looking for a split version is to:

  • Easily rewatch specific performances

  • Organize and archive each era individually

  • Analyze performances separately
If anyone has already split the film, or knows where I can find such versions, I would really appreciate any help or links.

Thank you so much in advance
